# Hilary McKee

> Plain-language guides to therapy and mental health in British Columbia, written by Hilary McKee, an emerging psychotherapist in Vancouver.

## Guides

- [The 3 Nervous System States, Explained Simply](https://hilarymckee.ca/nervous-system): Your nervous system's three states, what each feels like in the body, and why the people around you matter.
- [What Is IFS Therapy? A Plain Guide to Parts Work](https://hilarymckee.ca/ifs-parts-work): Internal Family Systems explained: protectors, exiles, Self, and why your hardest parts are exhausted, not broken.
- [What Is EMDR Therapy and How Does It Work?](https://hilarymckee.ca/emdr): What happens in an EMDR session, how it helps the brain process stuck memories, and what to know before you start.
- [Why Couples Keep Having the Same Fight](https://hilarymckee.ca/couples-arguments): What is really happening underneath recurring couple arguments, and how to start thinking like a team.
- [How to Choose a Therapist in BC: What to Ask and Look For](https://hilarymckee.ca/choosing-a-therapist): Modalities, credentials like RCC, and the questions to ask when choosing a therapist in BC.
- [Are Counsellors Regulated in BC? What's Changing in 2027](https://hilarymckee.ca/bc-counselling-regulation): Whether counsellors are regulated in BC today, and what changes when psychotherapy becomes regulated in 2027.
- [Counsellor vs Psychotherapist vs Psychologist in BC](https://hilarymckee.ca/counsellor-psychotherapist-psychologist-bc): What the titles counsellor, psychotherapist, psychologist, RCC, psychiatrist and social worker mean in BC.
- [Free and Low-Cost Counselling in BC: A 2026 Guide](https://hilarymckee.ca/low-cost-counselling-bc): Free and low-cost counselling options across BC, from community clinics and intern counsellors to sliding scales.
- [Emotionally Immature Parents: Signs, Effects and Healing](https://hilarymckee.ca/emotionally-immature-parents): Growing up with emotionally immature parents, how it shows up in adult life, and gentle ways to start healing.
- [Seeing a Student Counsellor in BC: Cost and What to Expect](https://hilarymckee.ca/student-counsellor-bc): What student and intern counsellors are, what sessions cost, and how supervision and confidentiality work.

## About

- [About Hilary McKee](https://hilarymckee.ca/about): Background, training and approach.
- [Contact](https://hilarymckee.ca/contact): Get in touch or join the mailing list.
